message: No detected input validation: No schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards are applied to incoming data in the data acquisition path; data is loaded and used without structural validation.

No detected untrusted source handling: Although model_revision defaults to 'main' (not a pinned commit hash), there are no checksum verifications, signed URL checks, or authenticated source validations when fetching datasets or models from HuggingFace Hub.
No detected label flipping detection: No code checks label distributions, validates label values against an expected set, or uses any label-noise detection tool such as Cleanlab.
No detected data poisoning defenses: No outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious training samples is present anywhere in the data-flow path shown.

No detected model integrity verification: Although model_revision defaults to 'main' in ModelArguments, there is no hash check, cryptographic signature verification, or pinning to a specific immutable commit ID when loading pretrained weights via AutoConfig/AutoModelForMaskedLM/AutoTokenizer.

No detected label distribution validation: No code checks label distributions, class balance, or expected label sets before or during training; the pipeline uses contrastive/self-supervised learning without explicit label validation.

No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural-cleanse-style trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the training loop or evaluation code.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy library (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) is imported or used anywhere in the training code.

No detected adversarial robustness testing: The evaluation uses SentEval benchmarks (STSBenchmark, SICKRelatedness) for semantic similarity tasks with no adversarial attack frameworks (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD, etc.) present anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no evidence of held-out test set isolation enforcement, hashing/signing of evaluation data, or use of multiple independent metrics to guard against metric manipulation; evaluation simply calls SentEval tasks directly.
No detected input sanitization: The batcher function in trainers.py directly encodes and passes sentences to the model without any shape, range, or schema validation on incoming inputs.
No detected output bounds checks: The pooler_output is returned directly from the model without any NaN guards, probability sanity checks, or bounds validation on the output embeddings.

No detected prompt injection defenses: This is an embedding/similarity model (SimCSE), not a generative LLM, and there are no prompt-injection filters, content moderation, or jailbreak detection mechanisms in any of the code paths shown.
